name: 风云三
english_description: A wuxia MUD whose archive is filed as “Storm III” (风云三) but whose actual in-game banner reads “Blood-and-Iron Jianghu” (铁血江湖) -- an unrelated title mismatch, not an error this project introduced. The map centers on the classic Huashan/Wudang/Mingjiao sect towns of central-plains jianghu, plus two overseas zones for cross-strait adventuring -- a Kobe/Japan area and a Taiwan area. New characters land at Yingxiao Restaurant (英豪酒楼), the largest tavern in the central city, and quitting is gated by a genuine 30-second post-login cooldown (“the file is still being saved”) -- one of the few libs in this collection to write anti-farming logic directly into the game design. Deep testing found and fixed a bug more severe than the usual soft-lock: the REVIVE_ROOM macro pointed at a temple file deleted years ago, found orphaned only in a stale backup directory, permanently stranding any character who died even without interruption -- repointed to the correct room after cross-referencing the backup against the live map, and verified live. See NOTES.md for the rest of the standard fix catalogue.
